CODE:
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Region': ['North America', 'East Asia', 'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'Latin America', 'Europe',
               'South Asia', 'Middle East & North Africa', 'Southeast Asia', 'Oceania', 'Central Asia',
               'Eastern Europe', 'Caribbean'],
    'Market_Reach': [88, 93, 67, 80, 90, 75, 70, 78, 85, 72, 82, 76],
    'Customer_Engagement': [80, 87, 72, 78, 85, 70, 68, 75, 82, 69, 80, 73],
    'Contract_Conversion': [75, 82, 62, 72, 80, 68, 64, 70, 76, 65, 77, 69],
    'Operational_Efficiency': [78, 85, 69, 76, 83, 72, 67, 74, 80, 70, 79, 72]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
regions = df['Region']
metrics = ['Market_Reach', 'Customer_Engagement', 'Contract_Conversion', 'Operational_Efficiency']
values = df[metrics].values

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
bar_width = 0.2
index = np.arange(len(regions))

colors = ['#4e79a7', '#f28e2b', '#e15759', '#76b7b2']

for i, (metric, color) in enumerate(zip(metrics, colors)):
    ax.bar(index + i * bar_width, values[:, i], bar_width, label=metric, color=color)

ax.set_xlabel('Region', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Score', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Export Market Performance Metrics by Region', fontsize=16, pad=20)
ax.set_xticks(index + bar_width * 1.5)
ax.set_xticklabels(regions, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
ax.legend(title='Metrics', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0)
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300)
